description.p: Mailin is a native desktop email client for IMAP and SMTP. It keeps a local SQLite cache for offline reading and stores passwords in the system keyring.

The Linux client is built with GTK 4 and libadwaita, renders HTML mail in a sandboxed WebKit view, blocks remote content until you allow it, and supports attachments, composition, replies, forwarding and desktop notifications.
First public release of Mailin, a native IMAP/SMTP desktop client for Linux and Windows.

ul.li: Offline-first mail with IMAP/SMTP sync, folder discovery, IDLE and CONDSTORE flag deltas.
GTK 4 client with HTML mail in a sandboxed viewer, remote-content blocking, attachments, compose, search and notifications.
WinUI 3 client with reader, attachments, compose, search and toast notifications.
PGP encryption and signing, an outbox with retry, draft auto-save and full-text search.
Flatpak packaging for Linux; zip, MSIX and Inno Setup installer for Windows, with checksums and build attestations.
Quick-action toggles and message defaults in WinUI preferences, with a restore-defaults button.
Recipient autocomplete for multi-recipient fields, and confirmation before every permanent deletion on Windows.

description.p: Known limitation: the WinUI client has no Unified Inbox in this release, and Windows artifacts are unsigned.
